title: Preparation for Delivery from Upper Tiers
scope_note: Section 4 (Procedure) steps 4.1-4.5 and Section 6 (Contingency Steps) of SOP-01-B, in DOH Warehouse Operations Manual, 2nd Edition 2022 (data/corpus/DOH_WOM-Manual.pdf, manual pages 94-96 = PDF pages 100-102). Step text is the Key Step column verbatim. Verified against the source document by the author on 2026-09-17; see data/graphs/VERIFICATION.md.

steps.text: Receive Delivery Notification Form (DNF) from the DOH Central Office or DOH Regional Office
Verify completeness of information of DNF
Perform contingency step 6.1: coordinate with the consignor pertaining any discrepancy or incomplete information on the delivery notification form
steps.condition: the information is incomplete or inappropriate

steps.text: Review and classify Delivery Notification based on the following: Urgency, Space Availability
steps.condition: the information is complete and appropriate

steps.text: Perform contingency step 6.2: coordinate with the consignor on the preferred date(s) of delivery based on your schedule of transactions, availability of space and staff; if delivery request shall be re-scheduled, indicate the reason accordingly
steps.condition: the delivery request cannot be accommodated

steps.text: Approve requests for deliveries specifying the date and time of delivery
steps.condition: the delivery request can be accommodated

steps.text: Prepare the warehouse and staff for the upcoming delivery
